top_signals.title: US Stocks Climb as Oil Decline Offers Relief After CPI Release
top_signals.summary: US stocks rallied as retreating oil prices and an earnings beat from Oracle Corp. boosted sentiment in the face of a report that showed accelerating core consumer prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: CPI Sets Up ‘Risk Management Hikes’ for Fed, Pimco’s Wilding Says
top_signals.summary: Tiffany Wilding, economist at Pimco, says US CPI data for August “does result in a Federal Reserve that is hiking interest rates.” She speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan says 'do nothing' about distillation as AI giants accuse China of copying their tech
top_signals.summary: At Y Combinator’s annual Demo Day, CEO Garry Tan explained why he's less concerned about frontier AI model distillation and the existential risk of AI.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
